name: git
what_it_is: GIT was initially designed and developed by Linus Torvalds for Linux kernel development. GIT is a free software that is designed to handle distributed revision control and source code management system. Easy to learn, it manages anything from small to large projects with speed and efficiency. Every Git clone is a full-fledged repository with complete history. It possess full revision tracking capabilities that are independent of network access or a central server.
